name: Britannia & Co. Restaurant
specialty: Mutton Berry Pulao, Sali Boti & Caramel Custard
description: Legendary 1923 colonial cafe famed for authentic Parsi recipes brought from Iran by the late Mr. Boman Kohinoor.

name: Leopold Cafe & Bar
specialty: Chilli Chicken, Roast Chicken, Draught Beer towers
description: Established in 1871, this bustling world-famous hangout was immortalized in Gregory David Roberts' novel Shantaram.

name: Cafe Mondegar (Mondi's)
specialty: Steak with Onion Rings, Keema Pav, Mario Miranda Cartoons
description: Mumbai's first cafe to house a vintage jukebox, covered with vibrant hand-painted cartoon murals by Mario Miranda.

name: Trishna Seafood Restaurant
specialty: Butter Garlic King Crab, Prawn Koliwada, Neer Dosa
description: Globally acclaimed coastal dining institution tucked in a quiet Fort alley, celebrated by international chefs for its buttery seafood.

name: Sardar Refreshments
specialty: Extra Butter Pav Bhaji & Cheese Pav Bhaji
description: Legendary late-night eatery famous for piping hot, molten-butter loaded Pav Bhaji simmered on gigantic iron griddles.

name: Aaswad Upahar & Mithai Griha
specialty: Award-Winning World Misal Pav, Kothimbir Vadi, Piyush
description: Winner of the 'World's Tastiest Vegetarian Dish' award at the 2015 Foodie Hub Awards in London for its spicy, aromatic Misal Pav.

name: Ashok Vada Pav (Kirti College)
specialty: Vada Pav with signature crunchy Chura & Garlic Chutney
description: The undisputed king of Mumbai Vada Pav operating for over 35 years, made with a proprietary spiced batter and crisp boondi chura.

name: Candies @ Mac Ronin
specialty: Chicken Macaroni, Mutton Puffs, Mini Burgers, Cold Coffee
description: Quirky Portuguese-villa style multi-level cafe featuring mosaic walls, cozy terrace corners, and pocket-friendly comfort bakery bites.

name: Gajalee Coastal Cuisine
specialty: Crisp Bombil Fry (Bombay Duck), Tandoori Crab, Solkadhi
description: Premier destination for authentic Konkani and Malvani sea catches prepared with fresh coconut milk, kokum, and hand-ground spices.

name: Juhu Chowpatty Chaat Hub
specialty: Sev Puri, Pani Puri, Dahi Batata Puri, Falooda, Rabdi Kulfi
description: Open-air beachside cluster of stalls serving tangiest Mumbai street snacks while enjoying evening sea waves.

name: Joey's Pizza
specialty: Meats / Tornado Pizza, Paneer Makhani Pizza with cheesy crust
description: A suburban cult favorite famous for generously topping every square inch of dough with spicy Indian-style meats and cheeses.

name: Guru Kripa Samosa & Chole
specialty: Samosa Chole with Tamarind Chutney, Dal Pakwan, Gulab Jamun
description: Iconic eatery since 1975 that once supplied fresh samosas to single-screen cinemas across Mumbai; famous for rich, tangy chole ladled over crispy samosas.
